Jane C. Loudon, The Mummy!
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/jane-c-loudon/the-mummy

People whose words are in the text, and their death dates:
- Jane C. Loudon, author and writer of an introduction. Death dates in the facts file: 1858-07-13.

First publication of the text used: 1828 (SE colophon: 'The Mummy! A Tale of the Twenty-Second Century was published in 1828 by Jane C. Loudon.')

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the edition's own rights statement (quoted below) says the text is in the United States public domain.
- Country of origin: the facts do not name the country of first publication. The possible countries for an English text are the United Kingdom, Ireland, the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, India and South Africa. Each has a term of life + 70 years or less for these deaths. The last person to die, Jane C. Loudon, died in 1858, so the text is public domain in each of these countries from 1 January 1929.
